# Glovax Technologies

> Glovax Technologies is a software house and AI/ML development agency based in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients in the UK and US. We build AI-powered web and mobile products, custom LLM/RAG systems, and SaaS platforms that drive real revenue.

## Company

- **Name:** Glovax Technologies
- **Expertise:** Full-stack development, AI/LLM engineering, RAG systems, and SaaS (5+ years, founder-led)
- **Location:** 31 K, DHA Phase 5, Lahore, Pakistan (remote-first; 6+ hours UK/US timezone overlap)

## Services

- **Web Development:** High-performance Next.js/React sites and SaaS with e-commerce, payments, and SEO-ready architecture.
- **AI & Machine Learning:** LLM-powered chatbots and assistants, RAG systems on your own documents, predictive analytics, and custom models (OpenAI, Mistral, LangChain).
- **Mobile Apps:** Cross-platform iOS & Android apps built with React Native.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS architecture, CI/CD pipelines, Docker & Kubernetes, infrastructure as code.
- **UI/UX Design:** Research-driven interfaces, design systems, and WCAG accessibility.
- **Digital Marketing:** SEO, PPC, content strategy, and conversion-rate optimization.

## Client & Security FAQs

- **Do you work with UK/US clients?** Yes — most clients are in the UK and US. We keep 6+ hours of overlap with London and Eastern US working hours.
- **How do payments work, and is it secure?** Fixed milestones with 30–50% upfront; invoices on every milestone; Upwork escrow available for extra protection.
- **Will you sign an NDA?** Yes, on request before we discuss your idea in detail. Your source code and IP always remain yours.
- **How do we communicate during a project?** Slack or WhatsApp for updates, Zoom for calls and demos, weekly live demos of progress.
- **What is your response time?** Within 24 hours on business days.
- **What happens after launch?** Every project includes a post-launch support window, plus optional extended support plans.
